newsitem.title: UK: ACPC to meet to study market stabilisation plans.
newsitem.headline: ACPC to meet to study market stabilisation plans.

text.p: The Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC) said on Tuesday it would examine members' proposals on coffee market stabilisation at a technical meeting in London next month.
The ACPC had at the last meeting on March 21 asked members to submit their proposals to the secretariat by April 15.
But an ACPC official said on Tuesday the secretariat would not publish the submissions beforehand.
The technical group is due to meet just before the full ACPC council meeting scheduled for May 21 in London.

The 14-member ACPC represents 80 percent of world production. The group's current one-year export programme aimed at limiting supplies through quota system expires at the end of June. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
